mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial registry or equivalent competent authority in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille and sworn Spanish translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: General and special power of attorney for pre-incorporation legal representation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille and sworn Spanish translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial ownership identification declaration (Declaración de titular real)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Each UBO, director, secretary and authorized signatory shall be screened against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, and the Bank of Spain security/registral sources. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for all PEPs, high-risk third-country nationals, and any counterparty connected with defense procurement. The compliance file must evidence contemporaneous screening at pre-incorporation and a rolling review, applying a risk-based approach under Ley 10/2010.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central (RMC) / Sistema de Información Registral (SIR) — online 'certificación de denominación social' platform (www.registradores.org)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed corporate name must be written in Spanish or in any co-official language (Catalan, Galician, Basque) using standard Latin alphabetic characters and permitted accent marks. The name must be presented in a single grammatical form, must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name, and must be transliterated into the Latin alphabet when using a foreign word. Punctuation is restricted to permitted separators; no lower-case-only overall style is allowed.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Registro Mercantil Central issues a negative certificate of denominación (name rejection), the applicant may file a recurso gubernativo with the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública within fifteen business days of notification. The appeal must annex a complete alternative name list and legal grounds. In cases where the initial denomination is reserved, the certificate may be renewed for an additional 90 days upon payment of the applicable arancel and submission of an extension request before expiry. All pending incorporation proceedings must be completed before the reservation expires.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not permissible as the registered office for an SL engaged in the manufacture of armored security personnel transport vehicles. The company must maintain a physical operating office in Spain for management, production security, and regulatory inspection. A virtual address may serve only as an ancillary communications address and shall not be used to demonstrate commercial substance.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official arancel of the Registro Mercantil Central; flat fee approximately USD 25

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial deed of incorporation including UBO declaration and statutes

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Inscription of the company in the Registro Mercantil Provincial
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Regulated registry arancel based on share capital and folio count; estimated USD 420

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague apostille and consular legalization of three foreign corporate and identity documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent foreign authorities and the Spanish Ministry of Justice / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-document apostille and legalization tariffs at approximately USD 50 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn translation of three non-Spanish corporate documents into Spanish
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn Translator appointed by the Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for sworn corporate document translation at approximately USD 100 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Defence trade control licence authorization application (material de defensa) pre-incorporation administrative dossier
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Industry, Trade and Tourism – Defence Material Control Directorate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fee schedule under Ley 53/2007 and Royal Decree 679/2014; advanced estimate USD 2,200

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for AML/CFT advisory and continuous screening; fixed professional fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Independent defence compliance consultant or authorized industrial security services firm

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: General pre-incorporation legal advisory and closing of the incorporation corpus
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Spanish law firm (abogado and procurador team)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for cross-border corporate defence work; fixed professional fee

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Royal Legislative Decree 1/2010 approving the consolidated text of the Spanish Companies Act (Ley de Sociedades de Capital), particularly Articles 4, 20, 22–23, 31–33, and 35; Royal Decree 1784/1996 approving the Commercial Registry Regulations; and Law 14/2013 on support for entrepreneurs and internationalisation, as amended.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: The Commercial Registry (Registro Mercantil) for the province of the registered office; the Central Commercial Registry (Registro Mercantil Central) issues the company-name availability certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Public deed of incorporation (escritura pública de constitución), filed with the competent Provincial Commercial Registry for registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: A Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada may be incorporated with capital of at least EUR 1. Until share capital reaches EUR 3,000, the company must allocate at least 20% of annual profit to legal reserve and, on liquidation with insufficient assets, shareholders are jointly and severally liable for the shortfall up to the difference between EUR 3,000 and subscribed capital. Capital contributions must be fully paid at incorporation; no general escrow requirement applies. Notary and registry charges may apply and are not included in the stated government filing fee.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Company accepts the subscriptions and contributions set out in the incorporation deed and confirms that the subscribed share capital has been fully paid in accordance with applicable law. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office stated in the deed is adopted as the Company’s registered office, subject to any required filing of a subsequent change. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [name] is appointed [sole director/joint directors/board member and chair] and [name] is appointed secretary, each to serve in accordance with the Articles and applicable law. Any director is authorized to complete registrations, obtain tax and electronic identification credentials, and make lawful filings necessary to implement these resolutions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Central Commercial Registry (Registro Mercantil Central), online name-certification service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit ranked proposed names and obtain a valid negative name certificate. The certificate must identify the intended founder or be issued in a form accepted by the notary. Reserve and use the name within the certificate’s validity period.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a proposed name is unavailable or confusingly similar, submit additional alternatives and obtain a replacement certificate before execution of the incorporation deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain identification and determine ownership and governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish Tax Agency (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria, AEAT) for tax identification; Spanish consulate or competent immigration authority where a foreign individual must obtain a NIE
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain a NIE for each foreign individual requiring one and a provisional NIF for a foreign corporate founder where applicable. Identify ultimate beneficial owners, select the registered office, business activities, capital, directors, and governance model. Foreign public documents must be apostilled or legalized and accompanied by a sworn Spanish translation where required.
required_dossiers: Foreign corporate registry extract and constitutional documents, if a corporate founder
Apostilles or legalization and sworn translations, where required
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct identification or beneficial-ownership inconsistencies and provide certified, legalized, or translated documents requested by the notary, AEAT, or registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute the incorporation deed before a notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver the name certificate, Articles of Association, founder details, capital allocation, and director acceptances. Execute the public deed. Contributions must be fully paid; a bank certificate may evidence cash contributions, although statutory alternatives may be available subject to the founders’ liability under the Companies Act. State the industrial and defense-related activities accurately; incorporation does not authorize regulated operations.
required_dossiers: Powers of attorney and legalized foreign corporate documents, where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Resolve notarial observations by correcting the deed, Articles, authority evidence, or contribution documentation and re-execute or supplement the instrument as directed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain the provisional tax number and complete tax formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish Tax Agency (AEAT), through its electronic office or competent tax office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the company’s provisional NIF using the incorporation deed and submit the required census declaration. Complete any applicable transfer-tax and stamp-duty filing; formation is generally exempt from the relevant corporate-operations charge, but the filing obligation should be confirmed for the transaction and autonomous community.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct the census declaration or identity and address records; respond to AEAT requests and obtain the definitive NIF after registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the company with the Provincial Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry (Registro Mercantil) for the province of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the authorized notarial copy of the incorporation deed and required tax evidence to the registry, electronically through the notary where available or by an accepted filing channel. Obtain the registration entry and definitive NIF. Registration confers legal personality as a limited liability company.
required_dossiers: Required registry forms and fee payment evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Cure registry defects within the stated period by filing corrected documents or a notarial rectification deed; appeal or seek review under applicable registry procedures if a rejection is disputed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete corporate books, beneficial-ownership, and operational registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Commercial Registry for legalization of corporate books; AEAT and relevant autonomous-community authorities for tax and industrial registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Maintain and electronically legalize the required minutes, shareholders’ register, and accounting books within statutory deadlines. File beneficial-ownership information through the applicable registry process. Register for relevant taxes, social security, and regional industrial-establishment requirements before commencing activity.
required_dossiers: Tax activity and employer registrations, as applicable
Facility and process information for industrial registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct incomplete book, beneficial-owner, tax, or industrial filings and submit outstanding information before commencing the affected activity.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Defence (Ministerio de Defensa), Directorate-General for Armament and Material (Dirección General de Armamento y Material, DGAM), for defense-material manufacturing authorization under Law 53/2007 and Royal Decree 679/2014; the relevant autonomous-community industrial authority for industrial-establishment registration and installation commissioning under Law 21/1992 and Royal Decree 559/2010.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Prior authorization for the establishment and activity of a defense-material manufacturing facility under Royal Decree 679/2014, together with applicable registration in the Integrated Industrial Register (Registro Integrado Industrial) and regional industrial commissioning approvals. Separate authorizations may be required for defense-material transfers, exports, and controlled technical assistance.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: The competent environmental authority of the relevant autonomous community; the Ministry for the Ecological Transition and the Demographic Challenge (Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico) is competent for projects reserved to the State under Law 21/2013.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Project-specific screening under Law 21/2013. A full ordinary EIA applies if the project falls within Annex I; simplified EIA or screening applies if it falls within Annex II or is otherwise referred for assessment. No categorical exemption can be assumed for an armored-vehicle manufacturing plant.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Obtain the applicable integrated environmental authorization or other environmental permit where required, wastewater discharge authorization from the competent basin authority or sewer operator, and air-emissions permits where applicable. Meet permit-specific limits and applicable national and EU requirements, including industrial emissions and solvent-VOC controls where relevant. Classify and manage hazardous and non-hazardous waste under Law 7/2022; no single numeric wastewater or VOC limit applies universally, and limits depend on process, permit, and receiving environment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Before operation, obtain applicable municipal planning, building, activity, and fire-safety approvals; comply with the Basic Building Code and applicable fire-protection rules, including Royal Decree 2267/2004 for industrial establishments. Secure required structural and installation inspections and regional commissioning approvals. Implement occupational risk prevention under Law 31/1995, including risk assessments, worker training, emergency procedures, and required workplace health and safety arrangements.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Tributaria, Spain's national tax authority and official portal at https://www.agenciatributaria.es/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities obtain statutory TIN (NIF/CIF) by submitting application to Agencia Tributaria via online portal or authorized representative, including company incorporation documents, passport, and proof of address.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box elections; Spain operates under territorial tax system with hybrid mismatch provisions under ATAD Directive.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) with digital stamps (sello electrónico) for all VAT-liable transactions; real-time reporting via API to AEAT for certain sectors.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to goods exported outside the EU or services to non-EU customers, requiring proof of actual export.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ED), Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent claims result in penalties of 100% of evaded VAT plus interest; clawback of benefits and possible criminal prosecution.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Eurozone member state with full capital account convertibility for residents and non-residents. Current account transactions (trade, services, profit remittances) unrestricted subject to standard KYC/AML verification. Capital account inflows require Bank of Spain declaration for amounts exceeding €50,000 equivalent; outbound capital repatriation permitted without restriction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Spanish-resident entities (including SL companies) must repatriate export proceeds within one year of shipment date. Foreign-currency export receipts mandatorily converted to euros and surrendered to a Spanish bank account. Non-resident beneficiaries may retain proceeds offshore without surrender obligation.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability for offshore EMIs due to high-risk defense sector classification under Spanish AMLD5 and EU AMLR; corporate EMIs restricted from handling defense-related transactions without special authorization.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of authorized directors or legal representatives required for initial corporate onboarding and KYC interview; remote video KYC and electronic signing permitted for subsequent verifications and ongoing compliance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Defense industry statutory license and export control compliance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Copy of manufacturing license (ISIC 3040), end-user certificates, dual-use export authorizations, and proof of compliance with EU Regulation 2021/821

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk customer due to military tactical hardware manufacturing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed business plan, end-client contracts, payment history, beneficial ownership structure, and source-of-funds documentation

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound wires via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'CAP' or 'EQU' for equity/capital contributions; mandatory verification through full KYC/AML dossier, beneficial ownership disclosure, and Bank of Spain declaration where applicable.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails via SWIFT MT103 for trade settlements; Commercial Letters of Credit under UCP 600 for international transactions; all disbursements require supporting documentation including commercial invoices, packing lists, and end-use certificates.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ordinary General Meeting (Junta General Ordinaria) annual accounts approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate body of Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada; certified minutes recorded in the corporate Minutes Book and notarized when required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 6 months after fiscal year-end (calendar year-end: by June 30)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Blocked distribution of profits, joint liability of directors, and incapacity to legally deposit annual accounts; persistent non-approval enables judicial dissolution proceedings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of Annual Accounts (Depósito de Cuentas Anuales) with certification of approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Commercial Registry (Registro Mercantil Provincial); centralized index at Registro Mercantil Central
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 month after approval of accounts; for calendar-year companies no later than July 31
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Registry closing (cierre registral) blocking all effective filings; late-deposit penalty between EUR 1,200 (delay up to 1 year) and EUR 60,000 (delay over 3 years) under Royal Decree 605/1999

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax return (Impuesto sobre Sociedades, Modelo 200)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 25 calendar days following the 6th month after fiscal year-end; for calendar-year taxpayers from July 1 to July 25 inclusive
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 5% (up to 3 months), 10% (up to 6 months), 15% (up to 12 months), or 20% (over 12 months) plus late-payment interest; flat penalty up to EUR 1,500 where no tax is due; tax assessment statute of limitations 10 years

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statement of transactions with third parties (Modelo 347)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: March 1 following each calendar year for transactions with third parties exceeding EUR 3,005.06
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of 1% of the aggregate amount of omitted transactions, minimum EUR 1,000 and maximum EUR 20,000; EUR 5,000 penalty for total non-filing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual legalization of statutory corporate books (Legalización de libros: Register of Members, Minutes Book, annual accounts and inventory ledgers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Commercial Registry (Registro Mercantil Provincial) via mandatory electronic filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after fiscal year-end; for calendar-year companies by April 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unlegalized books lose evidentiary value in commercial litigation; repeated omission causes registry refusal of subsequent filings and administrative fines under Commercial Registry disciplinary rules

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO) certification filed together with annual accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Commercial Registry (Registro Mercantil); Beneficial Ownership Register under Law 10/2010 and Royal Decree 609/2023
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month after approval of annual accounts; for calendar-year companies by July 31 and updated within 30 days of any shareholding change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative infringement under Law 10/2010 and RD 609/2023: fines up to EUR 60,000 for serious breaches; additionally registry closing until UBO certification is cured

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual economic activities tax (IAE) filing only if turnover exceeds EUR 1,000,000
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Municipal tax administration through Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), Modelo 840/845
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: First 20 calendar days of January each year for variations; full economic activities statement on annual basis when turnover exceeds EUR 1,000,000
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Immediate surcharge of 20% plus late-payment interest; penalty up to EUR 2,000 for omitted IAE declaration; for unregistered industrial activity, municipal license closure and regulatory revocation

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under Ley de Sociedades de Capital (Art. 263), mandatory independent audit when an SL meets at least two of the following in two consecutive years: total assets above EUR 2,850,000; net annual turnover above EUR 5,700,000; average workforce above 50 employees. Defense-regulated manufacturers are additionally subject to audit by the Ministry of Defense's economic-financial control regime when classified as an approved supplier of all-terrain military tactical vehicles.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish General Accounting Plan (Plan General de Contabilidad) approved by Royal Decree 1514/2007 for individual annual accounts; IFRS as adopted by the EU (statutory audit standards issued by ICAC) for consolidated groups; defense cost-economics accreditation under Spanish defense procurement accounting rules for NATO/ESDP framework contracts where the entity qualifies as a rated defense contractor.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SL must maintain an exact legal register of members and, for each shareholding transfer, record the deed, old and new owner, and date of registration before issuing corporate rights to the transferee. Annually, the directors must present a certification to the Commercial Registry identifying all ultimate beneficial owners holding 25% or more of ownership, voting rights, or control; any change in shareholding must be declared within 30 days. The annual UBO certification is attached to the approved annual accounts and is subject to registry suspension if incomplete or inconsistent with the Register of Members.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Annual Accounts and Inventory Book (Libro de Cuentas Anuales e Inventario)
Register of Contracts with the Sole Shareholder (Libro Registro de Contratos con el Socio Único) where applicable
Commercial Registry register entries for Directors (inscripción de nombramientos de administradores en el Registro Mercantil)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: Typical range EUR 1,200 - EUR 2,800 per annum for full Spanish SL registered office, professional agent, and annual corporate secretarial service
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Typical range EUR 5,500 - EUR 14,000 for an industrial manufacturer with turnover of EUR 5-20 million; defense-sector audit add-ons for cost-certification and military contract segregation may add EUR 2,500 - EUR 6,000
